name: Payment failed
description: A charge did not go through: what failed, what happens next, and the deadline before service is affected.

origin.note: Design: dunning notice — amber alert, the deadline as the largest element, one repair action.

subject: We couldn't take your payment for {{ product.name }}
preheader: Your account keeps working until {{ grace_ends_at }}. Updating the card takes a minute.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card that failed, so they know which one to fix.

failure_reason.description: What the processor said, translated into something a person can act on. "Insufficient funds" is useful; "do_not_honor" is not.
failure_reason.example: The card was declined by your bank

retry_at.description: When the charge will be attempted again, if it will be.

grace_ends_at.description: When service is actually affected. This is the fact the email exists to communicate.

consequence.description: What happens at that deadline, stated plainly.
consequence.default: After that the workspace becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted, and paying restores it immediately.

action_url.description: Where to update the payment method.

help_url.description: Optional link for people whose card is fine and who think this is a mistake.
